summary: liftIdeal(p^{c+1}) = liftIdeal(0) + (p^{c+1}) ⊆ liftIdeal(0) + p·(p^c) ⊆ liftIdeal(0) + p·liftIdeal(p^{c+1}); p lies in the Jacobson radical of the p-adically complete A_inf, so Nakayama gives the claim.
